title: Cold rebuild: the endpoint speed table
summary: Group a request log by path and export the average response time per endpoint, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *Group, measure and reshape* you turned a request log into a table of endpoints by
speed. Now do it again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution to peek at**. The check is exactly the
one you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to
the lesson, then try again tomorrow. This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: After `Group-Object Path`, where are the rows that belong to one path?
options: They are gone: Group-Object only keeps counts
steps.explain: `Name` is the value grouped on, `Count` the number of rows, and `Group` the rows themselves (unless you used `-NoElement`).

steps.title: The endpoint speed table, cold
prompt: Export `~/answers/slow.csv` from `~/data/requests.csv`: one row per `Path`, with exactly the columns `Path`, `Requests`
and `AvgMs` (the average `Ms`, rounded to a whole number), slowest first.
From memory: no hints this time.
